name: Plex Notifier
author: Thunderhat
description: Rank most-watched actors and directors from your Plex library, search people, track favourites, and email when they (or watchlist titles) appear on Freeview.

settingsSchema.label: Enabled
settingsSchema.help: Master switch for scheduled history refresh, Freeview matching, and digests.

settingsSchema.label: Libraries to scan
settingsSchema.help: Movie and TV libraries included in watch-history rankings and library ownership checks.

settingsSchema.label: Match movies
settingsSchema.help: Include movie airings and movie watchlist titles.

settingsSchema.label: Match TV
settingsSchema.help: Include TV airings and TV watchlist titles.

settingsSchema.label: Preferred Freeview region
settingsSchema.help: e.g. West Midlands. Chooses which BBC One / ITV regional variant to show when the same programme airs nationally. Leave blank to detect from Plex DVR.

settingsSchema.label: Only channels on my Plex DVR
settingsSchema.help: When Plex DVR is configured, ignore EPG channels that are not on your tuner lineup. This is the main location filter.

settingsSchema.label: Excluded channels
settingsSchema.help: Never match these channels (one per line). Defaults hide Ireland/international Freeview extras.

settingsSchema.label: Auto-schedule DVR recordings
settingsSchema.help: When a matched movie is not in your library, create a one-shot Plex DVR subscription. Requires Plex Pass and a configured DVR.

settingsSchema.label: DVR record library
settingsSchema.help: Movie library section where DVR recordings are saved (first selected is used).

settingsSchema.label: TMDB API key
settingsSchema.help: Required to search and match tracked actors/directors against Freeview. Get a free key from themoviedb.org.

settingsSchema.label: Send digests to
settingsSchema.help: Leave blank to use the default recipient on the Mail page. The mail server is set up there too.
